name: Implicit BVH for Sum of Bounded Functions
definition: A technique to efficiently find isosurfaces of an implicit function $F_n(\mathbf{p}) = \sum_{i=1}^n f_i(\mathbf{p})$ which is a sum of multiple bounded functions. It exploits the known range of each function to create a bounding hierarchy.
summary: Implicit BVH accelerates ray marching by using pre-sorted function ranges to compute on-the-fly bounds, enabling early termination without traversing a spatial tree structure.
